candidates.change_summary: Remove the overflow check requirement, allowing the require statement to always pass.
Change the balance update to add only half of msg.value.
Change unlockTime to always be block.timestamp regardless of argument.
Change unlockTime to always be the argument _unlockTime, ignoring block.timestamp.
Delete the balance update so msg.value is not added to acc.balance.
Delete the unlockTime update so acc.unlockTime retains its previous value.
Delete the require overflow check so large balances cause silent overflow.
Remove the requirement that block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime, allowing collection before unlock time.
Remove the minimum balance check `acc.balance >= MinSum`, allowing collection below the threshold.
Stop deducting `_am` from `acc.balance` so funds are not reduced after collection.
